resources.string: A transparent plan built only from what KX really measured: its own cache files and the history that aged out. Nothing is invented, and every destructive step needs your approval.
The plan could not be measured. Nothing is proposed and nothing was deleted.
Nothing to repair. The KX cache is empty and no history has aged out.
The KX cache could not be measured, so no cache file is proposed.
The cache walk hit its limit; only the measured files are listed.
Select at least one target first.
%1$d skipped because they changed since measurement
Autopilot acts only on KX\'s own cache and history. It never scans or deletes another application\'s files, never ends another application\'s session, and never invents a finding.
%1$d selected targets (%2$s) will be acted on. Cache files are deleted and aged history is pruned. This cannot be undone.
%1$d journal + %2$d usage entries older than %3$d days
